project.name: remex
project.productType: Bilingual on-site visit service landing page

motion.principle: Only the hero cycles real, commercially licensed Tokyo footage approximately every 6 seconds with a 0.8-second crossfade; text and lower sections stay static. Pause playback/cycling offscreen, in hidden tabs and on request. Reduced motion shows a static poster.

must: Preserve Japanese and English content and links
Keep service availability, pricing, permission requirements and legal terms accurate
Clearly label fictional illustrations; never imply real customer evidence
avoid: Generic slogans or decorative English eyebrows

decisions.decision: User requested several real-footage hero scenes switching every few seconds. Use a 6-second scene duration and 0.8-second crossfade; keep pause, reduced-motion poster and offscreen/hidden-tab pausing. Currently two temporal excerpts from the same verified Tokyo stock source, not different locations.
